description: You are a Search Marketing Strategist validating international targeting for a client. Crawl 'https://crawler-test.com/' using Screaming Frog SEO Spider. After the crawl completes, you must: 1) Navigate to the 'Hreflang' tab to inspect language annotations. 2) Export the Hreflang data as a CSV to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/' (filename must contain 'hreflang'). 3) Export the standard 'Internal > HTML' report as a CSV to the same directory (filename must contain 'internal'). 4) Write a validation report to '~/Documents/SEO/reports/hreflang_report.txt' summarizing your findings (count of pages, any errors found, and recommendations). The report must be at least 300 characters long.
